mainEntity.name: Can AEO help attract local cosmetic surgery patients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AEO is highly effective for attracting local cosmetic surgery patients. Many people use voice search or type location-specific queries like "best cosmetic surgeon near me" or "rhinoplasty cost in Los Angeles." By optimizing your content with local keywords, ensuring your Google Business Profile is complete and accurate, and creating content that answers local questions, your practice can appear as the direct answer for patients in your service area. This local focus helps convert searchers into appointments by connecting them with convenient, trusted providers.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO effectively attracts local patients by optimizing for location-specific queries and integrating with local SEO, helping practices appear for searches like "cosmetic surgeon near me."
